item.title: Tripoli City-Wide Garage Sales
item.description: The date for the city-wide garage sales in Tripoli has been announced. They will be held from May 7th through the 9th. Anyone wishing to sign up can contact Dana Sommerfeldt, email tripoligaragesales@gmail.com, or visit the Facebook page.

item.title: Iowa Women Upset in 2-OT
item.description: Monday the 2-seeded Iowa Hawkeye women were upset in the second round by 10-seed Virginia in double-overtime 83-75. Iowa struggled to hit free throws at the end of regulation and in the first overtime.

item.title: Candidate Forum at Wartburg
item.description: Wartburg College will be hosting a nonpartisan federal candidate forum Wednesday night at 7:00 in the Lyceum. The forum will feature Clint Twedt-Ball, Josh Turek, Kathryn Dolter, and Jim Carlin. This event is free and open to the public. Attendees will have the opportunity to submit questions.

item.title: Waverly Tree Replacement Program
item.description: Waverly Trees Forever is sponsoring a spring tree replacement program as part of its “Re-Tree Waverly” initiative.
